fact: The SIXP administrator, in a 26 August 2015 AfPIF talk, lists as a challenge that no carrier-neutral data centres are available in The Gambia, citing high operating cost and lack of economies of scale; the statement covers carrier-neutral facilities only, and says most websites are hosted abroad because local hosting is costly.
GAMTEL's service page says businesses and ISPs can rent space at any of its 43 sites to co-locate servers and networking hardware, with listed monthly floor-space and energy prices.
